mechanism: Bisacodyl-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium) combined with candesartan's potassium-retaining effects creates risk of hyperkalemia; chronic diarrhea from bisacodyl may also affect candesartan absorption and volume status.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function periodically; avoid chronic bisacodyl use; consider alternative laxatives like polyethylene glycol; counsel patient on dietary potassium intake.
